content:
mira: starting int4 canary for bluejay-11b on lowlat pool. quick smoke then evals. keeping defaults initially.
liam: saw drop on our invoice-date parse eval: EM 0.85 -> 0.79 after int4 artifacts. consistent across seeds.
rowan: reproduced intermittent OOMs under modest concurrency (7). allocator logs show heavy slab churn and high gc cycles.
anya: repro command: single request with max_new_tokens=1100 + microbatch=3 fails after ~20 tokens. runtime snippet: ```ERR allocate_kv_page(24MB) failed; slab_free_count=0; gc_runs=94```
mira: bluejay tokenization expands some date forms; effective seq len higher than expected so KV pressure spikes.
liam: quality hit seems tied to per-layer clip we used during int4 mapping; LN-adj layers looked noisy.
rowan: hypothesis: quant tweak increases per-token KV writes -> freelist thrash -> allocator slow-path -> timing perturbations -> token stability issues.
anya: observed low-confidence token replacements on failing runs. timing-sensitive.
liam: propose mitigations: 1) lower default max_new_tokens to 512 for the int4 variant 2) enable kv_warmup on first request 3) narrow per-layer clip near LN layers and regen artifacts 4) cap microbatch concurrency per GPU to 6
mira: agree on lowering defaults; covers most product flows.
rowan: runtime patch: add per-thread free-reserve (deferred_free_bucket) behind flag for canary to smooth freelist contention.
anya: sample canary config: ```model: bluejay-11b
variant: int4
quant_clip: {ln_post:0.005, att_out:0.007}
defaults: {max_new_tokens:512, microbatch_limit:6, kv_warmup:true, deferred_free_bucket:true}```
ops-bot: deploy queued: deploy/bluejay-11b-int4 -> pool-lowlat-07 by mira @1991112400
deploy-bot: basic health OK after 5m; p50 +2ms, p95 +10ms; RSS -17% vs int8; slab_free_ratio improved after flag.
liam: re-run evals: date-parse EM = 0.83 after clip tweak + defaults lowered. regressions reduced and within rollback threshold.
rowan: 36h soak with synthetic ramps up to concurrency 6: no OOM, slab_gc_runs down ~5x, microbursts rare.
anya: will add a token-stability test to onboarding CI to catch timing-induced flips: 
"./ci/run_token_stability.sh --model bluejay-11b --variant int4 --iters 40 --suite date-parse" -> /evals/runs/1991112222-tokenstab.log
mira: action items: liam finalize clip map + regen int4 artifacts (ETA 3h), rowan land deferred_free_bucket flag (ETA 2h), ops lower max_new_tokens->512 + kv_warmup (done), anya add token-stability CI (ETA tomorrow).
liam: note for catalog: "bluejay-11b (int4): requires reduced max_new_tokens and kv_warmup; see allocator notes"
rowan: long-term: consider transient KV reservations or dynamic page sizing if 1k+ token flows are required.
mira: thanks team. monitor 48h and reopen if EM drifts. :eyes:
